subscriptions.get.sql: SELECT s.id, s.account_id, a.tenant_id, s.plan_id, s.status, s.seats_in_use, s.current_period_start, s.promo_lock_until, s.version FROM subscriptions s JOIN accounts a ON a.id = s.account_id WHERE s.id = ? AND a.tenant_id = ?

members.get.sql: SELECT user_id, role FROM account_members WHERE account_id = ? AND user_id = ?

plans.target.sql: SELECT id, purchasable, seat_limit FROM plans WHERE id = ?

invoices.pending.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM invoices WHERE subscription_id = ? AND status = 'pending'

history.period.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM plan_change_history WHERE subscription_id = ? AND changed_at >= ?

change.compute.sql: SELECT cur.monthly_price_cents AS cur_price, cur.feature_tier AS cur_tier, tgt.monthly_price_cents AS tgt_price, tgt.feature_tier AS tgt_tier, s.current_period_start AS period_start, s.current_period_end AS period_end FROM subscriptions s JOIN plans cur ON cur.id = s.plan_id JOIN plans tgt ON tgt.id = ? WHERE s.id = ?

statements.sql: UPDATE subscriptions SET plan_id = ?, version = version + 1, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ? AND version = ?
INSERT INTO credit_notes (id, subscription_id, amount_cents, reason, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
INSERT INTO plan_change_history (id, subscription_id, from_plan_id, to_plan_id, direction, proration_cents, changed_by, changed_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
INSERT INTO invoice_items (id, subscription_id, invoice_id, amount_cents, description, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, NULL, ?, ?, ?)
INSERT INTO plan_change_requests (id, subscription_id, from_plan_id, to_plan_id, proration_cents, requested_by, status, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'pending', ?)
